styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate has 15 visible tones per 16x16 tile, against 17 for the cheese stall, 20 for the well and 9 for the hedge, so it sits inside the reference range. Near-flat coverage is 2% (the stall has 13%), so there are no large flat fills. The dark edge pixels are 0% near-neutral, which means the outlines carry a tint, here a dark rose-brown beside the pink and wood. By eye, the pink valance has stripe and scallop variation, the heart has an inner highlight, and the wood front has a row of light dots. I count about 4 steps on the pink and wood ramps, a little below Beodeul's 5-6, and total colours (19) are well under the stall (40) and well (38).
